description: Cypriot company officers from the Registrar of Companies open data (DRCOR, data.gov.cy, CC BY 4.0, monthly national snapshot): every mandate published for the company (directors, alternate directors, company secretaries, assistant and deputy secretaries, authorised persons of overseas companies), with the register's Greek role label and a closed-list family (role.famille), sorted by family then name; `aucun_mandat_publie` is measured on the complete snapshot. Name and role only: the source publishes no birth date, address, nationality or appointment date, and does not tell natural persons and corporate officers apart. Legal persons only: HE (company) and AE (overseas company); business names, partnerships and BN are refused before payment. Beyond 45 days without a new DRCOR publication the answer stays served and dated (`sans_publication_neuve`, `data_freshness`, perime in provenance; a zero is then non-conclusive); 503 fail-closed only when the snapshot is missing or our collection has not re-read the source for 45 days. Paid via x402 ($0.01). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

id.description: Cypriot registration number with its prefix: HE (company) or AE (overseas company), e.g. HE165 or AE1 (ΗΕ 165 accepted)

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.
